title: Printable Adult Halloween Colouring Book | Gothic Skeleton Masquerade Line Art, Instant Digital Download
description:
Settle in for a cosy-spooky colouring session inside a manor where every masked guest has a secret. 🕯️ This elegant Halloween book brings a little playful mystery to your creative time.

Hollowbone Manor Masquerade is filled with sophisticated monochrome pen-and-ink illustrations of skeleton masqueraders in a decaying manor ballroom draped with autumn garlands. Decorative architecture and ornate surfaces offer satisfying detail, while generous open areas keep each page comfortable to colour. The result is candlelit seasonal warmth with a deliciously ominous twist. 🎃

A few scenes from the masquerade

The Iron Gate opens on cloaked skeletal guests approaching a weathered Gothic manor, with pumpkins, ivy, bare branches and a crescent moon overhead.

The Grand Stair sweeps beneath carved arches as costumed skeletons descend among jack-o'-lanterns, autumn foliage and candle sconces.

Raven's Toast brings a raven-beak-masked guest to a moonlit conservatory, complete with curling vines, leaded glass and a perched raven.

The Midnight Supper sets an elaborate banquet beneath candelabra and tapestries, while The Skeleton Orchestra fills a carved balcony with five skeletal musicians and decorative swirling music.
